programme: OI-BH-1 (../PROGRAMME.md), items BH-02 and BH-04, lane 3
kind: local run; not a CI run and not a check-run attestation

recipe.exit_status: checks.py prints VOID and exits 2 on any failed control; mutants.py exits 2 unless every mutant is caught; report.py exits 2 if result.json records a failed control

determinism: result.json reproduced byte for byte by two runs under -I -B and one under -I -B -O on the recorded interpreter; REPORT.md reproduced byte for byte; mutants-output.txt from one run of the final code
seeds: fixed in checks.py (SEEDS) and echoed in result.json
